newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA NEWS HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA NEWS HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Parliament upper and lower chambers resumed sessions.
* Visiting British Foreign office secretary Sir Nicholas Bonsor praised the excellent relations with Romania during a meeting with Romanian Foreign Minister Adrian Severin.
* The Parliament Palace hosts the European Union conference on PHARE projects for Central and Eastern Europe.

Candidates for EU membership have excellent opportunities to cooperate within PHARE's multi-country projects, Romanian European Integration Minister Alexandru Herlea said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
